EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
,, Notice under Section 7

Land Ministry’s No.: 4-3/2/2018/S/66. My Reference No.: BER/4/5/3/5. I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/ Servitude which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the land or Servitude to be acquired:

One allotment of Land in total extent of 0.0095 Hectare known as Lot No. 1 in Sheet No. 1 of Block No. 2 of Cadastral Map No. 530722 dated 24.12.2024 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at Village of Kaluwamodara in Grama Niladhari Division of No. 762A
Kaluwamodara, North of Divisional Secretary’s Division of Beruwala in Kalutara District, Western Province. Morefully described as follows:
Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Mahakoodaluwelakumbura; Description: Garden and Permanent Building; Claimant: Divisional Secretary, Beruwala; Extent: 3.8 Perches. Description of boundaries:

North: Road and Mahakoodaluwelakumbura possessed by N. K. Pradeep Nishantha Silva; East: Road and Mahakoodaluwelakumbura possessed by N.K. Pradeep Nishantha Silva; South: Mahakoodaluwelakumbura possessed by N. K. Pradeep Nishantha Silva; West: Mahakoodaluwelakumbura possessed by N. K. Pradeep Nishantha Silva. All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Beruwala on the 26th day of

23rd day of January 2025. EOG 02-0139
CORRIGENDA THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

Acquiring Lands for the Construction of Passara Puhulwatte Lake, Upper Uva Development Program Stage 01 Reference No. of the Ministry of Lands: 4/3/9/2011/IR/189. Reference No. of the Divisional Secretary: BD/PS/LND/4/1/6-II. This is with reference to the Notice under Section 7 published in the Part III of the Gazette Extraordinary bearing Number 1796/11 on 07th of February 2013. As the paper advertisement was not published by mistaken, the ownership inquiries will be held again on 21/03/2025 by cancelling the ownership inquiry held on 28.03.2013 and all those who claim ownership, interest and any other connection to land lots from 01 to 25, should appear personally before me at Divisional Secretariat, Passara. In addition, hereby requested to notify to me in writing with two copies of the nature of their interests in the lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of computation of such amount before 14.03.2025. N. J. T.Anuradha, Divisional Secretary (Acting), Passara.
Divisional Secretariat, Passara. 07th February 2025.
